messages:
Tess: quick PSA: nightly lint flagged handbook/quickstarts/fast-api.md for two issues: missing owner and a dead internal shortlink (#examples -> 404). anyone able to grab?
Ravi: I can take the shortlink fix. do we know which page references #examples?
Tess: runtime-guide/examples.md links to it. console from the lint job shows: `Broken link: /handbook/quickstarts/fast-api.md -> handbook/runtime-guide/examples.md#examples (404)`
ci-bot: nightly-docs-lint: job 9123 detected broken-internal-link and missing-owner on handbook/quickstarts/fast-api.md. See CI details: https://ci.internal/9123
docs-bot: suggestion: add frontmatter owner and replace shortlink with absolute path or add redirect entry. Recommended owner: @Nora (recent edits).
Nora: I can add owner frontmatter and skip the shortlink route. plan: 1) add `owner: @Nora` to top of fast-api.md, 2) change the fragment link to `#quickstart-examples` which exists in examples.md, 3) open PR with a short changelog.
Ravi: for the fragment rename, prefer adding an HTML anchor comment in examples.md too so old links don't break: `<!-- anchor: quickstart-examples -->`. I'll make that change in the PR if you want.
Tess: sounds good. small checklist: update frontmatter, fix link, add anchor comment, run local docs-lint.
Nora: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9999 title: "assign owner + fix shortlink -> anchor (fast-api)" — @Ravi please review for anchor comment and link target.
Ravi: reviewing now, left 1 nit about a relative path that should be prefixed with /handbook. pushing fix.
Nora: pushed change. CI green. merging.
ci-bot: merge: PR #9999 merged by @Nora. retriggering nightly job 9124.
docs-bot: automated-scan: handbook/quickstarts/fast-api.md owners set (owner=@Nora). broken-internal-link resolved.
Tess: thanks team. small follow-up: I'll add a quick note to #eng-standup so onboarding sees the corrected examples. if anyone else spots shortlinks in the wild, drop the page path here and we'll triage. :coffee:
Ravi: nice and tidy, thanks :thumbsup:
Nora: np — happy to own this one.
